newsitem.title: USA: American Federal, CCB Financial to merge.
newsitem.headline: American Federal, CCB Financial to merge.

text.p: CCB Financial Corp said Tuesday it has definitively agreed to buy American Federal Bank FSB for $325.1 million in stock.

The pact calls for AMFB shareholders to receive 0.445 common shares for each AMFB share. The tax-free exchange is valued at $28.86 a share based on CCB's five day average closing stock price through Friday of $64.85, the companies said.
American Federal shares closed Friday at 21-1/2. Monday was a holiday.
The companies said the deal will create the sixth largest bank in the Carolinas with assets of about $6.9 billion and deposits of $5.5 billion.
Additionally, AMFB said it has granted CCB an option to buy up to 19.9 percent of its outstanding shares under certain circumstances.
The merger is subject to approvals but is expected to be completed by the third quarter of 1997.

AMFB President and Chief Executive Roy Abercrombie will become vice chairman of CCB under the deal. Three other AMFB board members will also be added to the CCB board, which will be increased to 23 members, the companies said.
